rosmap_clinical.warning: ages are top-coded '90+'; do NOT use for the age axis

roles.age_at_visit: NOT PRESENT -- derived as age_bl + fu_year
roles.per_visit_diagnosis: NOT PRESENT -- dcfdx is absent from this release
roles.cognition_composite: cogn_global (global only -- the 5 domain scores cogn_ep/se/po/ps/wo are NOT in this release)
roles.raw_tests: NOT PRESENT -- no cts_* item scores except the estimated MMSE cts_estmmse30

projid.codebook_note: RADC participant id; join key across all three tables

apoe_genotype.codebook_note: 22/23/24/33/34/44; NOT ordinal -- e2 is protective, e4 risk

age_first_ad_dx.codebook_note: age at FIRST cycle with dcfdx in {4,5}; missing if demented at baseline

cogng_demog_slope.codebook_note: random slope of cogn_global from an LME over the WHOLE follow-up

age_bl.codebook_note: age at baseline assessment, (visit date - dob)/365.25; NOT capped

died.codebook_note: 1 died / 0 alive as of the data freeze

educ.codebook_note: years of regular school, reported at baseline

ldai_bl.codebook_note: lifetime daily alcohol intake at baseline, drinks/day

braaksc.codebook_note: Braak NFT stage 0-6, ascending severity; AUTOPSY ONLY

ceradsc.codebook_note: CERAD 1 definite / 2 probable / 3 possible / 4 no AD -- REVERSE coded; AUTOPSY ONLY

gpath.codebook_note: global AD pathology burden, 3 measures x 5 regions; AUTOPSY ONLY

pmi.codebook_note: post-mortem interval (hours); AUTOPSY ONLY -- presence alone implies death

amylsqrt_est_8reg.codebook_note: sqrt amyloid density, 8 regions; AUTOPSY ONLY

lewydx_st4.codebook_note: Lewy body disease stage; AUTOPSY ONLY

tangsqrt_est_8reg.codebook_note: sqrt tangle density, 8 regions; AUTOPSY ONLY

caa_4gp.codebook_note: cerebral amyloid angiopathy, 4 groups; AUTOPSY ONLY

fu_year.codebook_note: follow-up cycle index; 0 = baseline. THE ONLY time field in the release

r_stroke.codebook_note: clinician stroke dx: 1 highly probable / 2 probable / 3 possible / 4 NOT present -- REVERSE coded

cogn_global.codebook_note: global cognition z, mean of 19 tests; z uses the BASELINE-cycle cohort mean/sd

r_depres.codebook_note: clinician major depression dx: 1 highly probable ... 4 NOT present -- REVERSE coded

bmi.codebook_note: body mass index, measured at each visit

hypertension_cum.codebook_note: self-reported hypertension EVER UP TO this cycle -- cumulative, monotone

dm_cum.codebook_note: self-reported diabetes ever up to this cycle -- cumulative, monotone

chf_cum.codebook_note: congestive heart failure ever up to this cycle -- cumulative, monotone

claudication_cum.codebook_note: claudication ever up to this cycle -- cumulative, monotone

heart_cum.codebook_note: heart condition ever up to this cycle -- cumulative, monotone

antihyp_rx.codebook_note: antihypertensive taken in the 2 weeks before THIS visit -- point-in-time

diabetes_rx.codebook_note: diabetes medication at this visit -- point-in-time

ad_rx.codebook_note: AD medication at this visit -- point-in-time

berlin_risk_class.codebook_note: Berlin questionnaire high risk of sleep apnea

Study.codebook_note: cohort label in the ROSMAP release

age_at_visit_max.codebook_note: age at last visit -- DE-IDENTIFIED, top coded as the string '90+'

age_death.codebook_note: age at death -- DE-IDENTIFIED, top coded as the string '90+'

cts_mmse30_first_ad_dx.codebook_note: MMSE at the first AD dx cycle

cts_mmse30_lv.codebook_note: MMSE at the LAST valid cycle

cogdx.codebook_note: FINAL consensus cognitive dx (post-mortem informed for autopsied)

dcfdx_lv.codebook_note: clinical dx at the LAST valid cycle -- 1 NCI / 2 MCI / 3 MCI+ / 4 AD / 5 AD+ / 6 other dementia
